name: BK Concentration
summary: BK Concentration takes the old game for a new ride. There are multiple levels and each one is more challenging than the last, good luck!

name: BK Simulator
summary: A simple Idle game, designed specifically for use with the Archipelago Randomizer program. Walk to 'BK' to get lunch, and find random items; either for yourself (ex. to help you walk faster), or for others in your randomizer room (to help them with whatever game they are playing).
